name: GWF World Title
notes: The fed's own top singles title, introduced in its founding document as mandatory-defense at least twice a month.
epitaph: Introduced as the GWF's own top singles title, reserved in its founding document for "the best of the best"; no title match is attested.

name: GWF US Title
notes: The fed's own second-ranked singles title, introduced in its founding document as mandatory-defense at least three times a month.
epitaph: Introduced as the GWF's own second-ranked singles title, requiring three defenses a month by its founding document's own rule; no title match is attested.

name: GWF Extreme Title
notes: The fed's own third-ranked singles title, pitched in its founding document for extreme wrestlers.
epitaph: Introduced as the GWF's own third-ranked singles title, pitched in its founding document for extreme wrestlers; no title match is attested.

name: GWF Television Title
notes: The fed's own weekly-defended television title, billed in its founding document as a launching pad for younger wrestlers.
epitaph: Introduced as a weekly-defended launching pad for younger wrestlers in the GWF's own founding document; no title match is attested.

name: GWF Cruiserweight Title
notes: The fed's own cruiserweight-division title, restricted in its founding document to wrestlers under 235 pounds and defended weekly.
epitaph: Introduced as the GWF's own cruiserweight title, restricted to wrestlers under 235 pounds and defended weekly by its founding document's own rule; no title match is attested.
